verdict.rationale: Wise Business docs support global/domestic payments, ACH direct-debit funding accounts, batch transfers up to 1000 payments, SWIFT gpi tracking, and multi-currency balances — core plumbing for paying vendors via ACH/wire is present ([wise-docs-23],[wise-docs-28],[wise-docs-34],[wise-docs-1],[wise-docs-2],[wise-docs-6]). However, community evidence shows real-world friction: accounts (including business) can have US account numbers changed with zero notice disrupting vendor payments, and one business's Wise Business account was fully blocked over a profile-category mismatch, undermining reliability for ongoing vendor AP use ([wise-comm-3],[wise-comm-5],[wise-comm-6]). Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation naming 'ACH' and 'wire' as distinct outbound payment rails to US vendors, and independent confirmation that vendor payments proceed reliably without account-detail disruptions.
